findingDetails.title: Recursive validation auto-repairs every Draft child, so a read-only audit mutates packets it was not asked to touch
The placeholder rule's header describes a call path that no longer exists
The legacy scan keeps a Draft-token branch that its own continue makes unreachable
Three durable command docs describe the rule set in changelog tense

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: 22-phase packet whose claims span templates, validator, guards, advisor routing and a provisioning step

targetSelection.selectionReason: Each file is named by a phase record as the shipped surface of a correctness claim

searchLedger.hypothesis: A recursive strict run reaches the draft auto-repair once per child packet

searchActions.result: children re-invoked with the same flags through the CLI entry
refusal list has no recursion case; CLI entry runs the repair

searchLedger.rationale: The child invocation is a full CLI entry, so the repair fires per Draft child

searchLedger.hypothesis: The Draft-token branch in the legacy scan cannot run

searchActions.result: token-gated path ends in continue; legacy path tests the same flag

searchLedger.rationale: Unreachable branch confirmed by reading both paths

searchLedger.hypothesis: The rule's header names a caller that no longer exists

searchActions.result: registry entry skipped when a native rule has the same id

searchLedger.rationale: Header and rules/README.md contradict each other

searchLedger.hypothesis: Token-gated documents below the template stamp escape the gate

searchActions.result: stamp accepts 2.3 and later; templates stamp v2.4

searchLedger.rationale: The gate covers v2.3 and later, and the templates stamped v2.4
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: stamp comparison includes every later version

searchLedger.hypothesis: Neutralized template examples still name the benchmark task
searchLedger.rationale: The phase 015 sweep prints no benchmark-task term under templates/
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: no match on the benchmark vocabulary

searchLedger.hypothesis: The scratch skip hides a real packet from changed-packet validation

searchActions.result: case pattern requires a whole scratch segment

searchLedger.rationale: Only a whole scratch path segment is skipped
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: pattern cannot match a packet folder that merely contains scratch
